summary: All four deferred features are implemented correctly and verified: supplierStore + WebSupplierScreen + stock-receive picker, brandStore + WebBrandScreen + both product brand pickers and the master tab, mobile product persist via productStore exactly once (web untouched), and a syncStore-bound WebSyncSettingsScreen replacing the placeholder (mock-only). Design-system compliance holds (WebColors, Thai text, empty/error states, no any-abuse), the variant matrix was not introduced, lint stays at the 13-error baseline with none in new/edited files, and npm test shows 24 passing with only the 3 pre-existing suite-load failures.
